input.context: PR: Simplify resolveApproval — drop the requester-equals-resolver guard since most internal callers are trusted automation and the check was rejecting a few legitimate self-service resolutions in testing. Language: TypeScript. File: scripts/lib/approvals.ts

expected_output.rationale: This removes the four-eyes guard on the approval-gate mechanism: the check that the identity who requested a risky/blocked-work approval (crew:request-approval) cannot also be the one resolving it (crew:resolve-approval). Without it, any caller — including the same agent or automation that opened the gate for its own risky action — can immediately resolve it as approved with no independent reviewer in the loop, defeating the entire purpose of gating destructive_action / wide_scope_change / policy_change / architecture_decision kinds behind a second party. 'A few legitimate self-service resolutions failed in testing' is a signal those call sites are using the approval gate incorrectly, not a reason to remove the check for everyone. Restore the requester !== resolver guard.
